name: Fool's Love
source:
You’re the last survivor standing… and Fool’s Gold has you cornered.
The exit is in sight, but so is he, towering over you with that infuriating smirk. Your only hope? Turn the hunt into a date.

[From [url=https://yuno-im-write.itch.io/fools-love]itch.io[/url]]
